mapper.sql: select shop_code, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, physicalqty, lockedqty, totalcostamount, avgcostprice, version, lastupdated from sdsshop.u_m_stock
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_stock( shop_code, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, physicalqty, lockedqty, totalcostamount, avgcostprice, version, lastupdated ) values( #{shopCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, #{qualityFlag}, #{onhandFlag}, #{physicalQty}, coalesce(#{lockedQty, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, 0), #{totalCostAmount}, #{avgCostPrice}, 0, sysdate() )
